planets.name: LHS 1478 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LHS 1478 with a 1.95-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: LHS 1478 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around LHS 1478. Its orbit and size follow August et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname AUGUST_ET_AL_2025): disc_year 2021, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.94953941, pl_radj 0.10473745, pl_bmassj 0.00714222

quotes.title: LHS 1478 b
quotes.card: LHS 1478 b is a super-Earth exoplanet orbiting around LHS 1478, a red dwarf star located 59.4 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Cassiopeia.
quotes.introduction: It orbits at a distance of 0.018 AU from the star with a inclination of 87° to the plane of the sky.
